item.title: Shareholders vote Mayfield directors off board paving way for Embark to assume control
item.description: Mayfield shareholders have overwhelmingly voted to carry a series of Director focused resolutions at its General Meeting held yesterday 25 November 2026 that will see three Directors removed from the Board and two new Directors appointed.

item.title: Childcare start-up that let parents work beside their babies collapses owing $900,000
item.description: Co-working and onsite childcare start-up BubbaDesk, which had the backing of an ASX-listed company and boasted partnerships with major companies including Canva, has fallen into administration owing at least $900,000, leaving staff and families in limbo, the Daily Telegraph reported on 25 November. Founder Lauren Perrett said attempts to sell the business had so far proven unsuccessful and that changes to capital gains tax had thwarted its public capital raise, the Telegraph reported.

item.title: Goodstart's election push draws Free Kinder pledge from Coalition, but no party commits on long day care funding
item.description: Shadow Minister for Education Brad Rowswell has told Goodstart Early Learning that a Liberals and Nationals Government would keep Free Kinder and run an Early Learning Structural Review, in a letter dated 16 November. Mr Rowswell wrote that the Coalition had “no intention of stopping the rollout of Free Kinder”.

item.title: SNAICC wants an independent ECEC commission that funds what ACCOs actually do
item.description: SNAICC Council member Richard Weston has told a Senate inquiry that the proposed Early Education and Care Commission is “a significant opportunity” for Aboriginal community-controlled services, according to a SNAICC media release issued on 24 November. Mr Weston said the commission must be genuinely independent, informed by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander expertise and work in partnership with communities.

item.title: ELAA chief executive Dr Karina Davis resigns while the Victorian kindergarten pay parity deal sits with Fair Work
